title_en: Call for Applications: 2027 First Jeongjik (Honesty) Scholarship
summary: Current third-year students in the College of Engineering who will advance to fourth year in the 2027 academic year may apply for the 2027 First Jeongjik (Honesty) Scholarship of USD 10,000 per year. Applicants must email one copy of each required document to the department office by 17:00 on Wednesday, 25 November 2026; the email address is given in the original notice. The selected student must attend the scholarship award ceremony planned for the end of February.
applies_to: Current third-year students of the College of Engineering at this university who are due to advance to fourth year in the 2027 academic year. Candidates should have contributed to building a sound academic community and should show exemplary leadership, at regional and national level, through consideration for others and a positive influence. Application is voluntary for interested students. Each department nominates one student, and one student is selected for the whole College of Engineering.

dates.what: Deadline to email the application documents to the department office
Selection of the recipient (during the student's third-year second semester)
Award and payment of the scholarship to the selected student (during the student's fourth-year first semester)
Scholarship award ceremony; attendance is mandatory for the selected student

conditions: Only current third-year College of Engineering students who will be fourth-year students in the 2027 academic year are eligible.
Each department (school) recommends one student, and only one student is selected for the entire College of Engineering.
The self-introduction must include your values in life so far and your resolve for the future.
The recommendation letter must be from the dean, your academic advisor or an acquaintance.
Evidence of activities during university (volunteering, student council or other group activities, awards and commendations) is submitted only if you have it.
The selected student must attend the award ceremony planned for the end of February.
The amount is USD 10,000 per person per year; the amount paid in Korean won changes each year with the exchange rate applied when the fund is transferred (13,296,090 won for 2027).

In the first year, one student each is selected from the College of Engineering and the College of Social Sciences; from the following year, one student is selected in alternate years from each college (College of Engineering first, then College of Social Sciences).
steps: Read the attached operating plan (제1회 정직장학금 운영(안).docx).
Download the self-introduction and recommendation letter forms (정직장학 자기소개서 및 추천서.hwp) and the recommendation list form (2027학년도 정직장학생 추천 양식.xlsx).
Write the self-introduction on the form, including your values in life so far and your resolve for the future.
Obtain a recommendation letter on the form from the dean, your academic advisor or an acquaintance.
If you have them, gather documents proving activities during university (volunteering, student council or group activities, awards and commendations).
Complete the Excel recommendation list (정직장학생 추천 명단).
Email one copy of each document to the department office by 17:00 on Wednesday, 25 November 2026; the email address is in the original notice.
translation:
2027 First Jeongjik (Honesty) Scholarship: Selection of Recipients

We announce the selection of recipients for the 2027 First Jeongjik (Honesty) Scholarship [정직장학금] as follows. Interested students are asked to apply.

1. Fund overview
 - Donors: donors from a US-based foundation (donations 2023–2025 and 2025); names are given in the original notice.
 - Purpose: to identify and support talented students who practise sound leadership based on an honest character and a sense of social responsibility, and who contribute to the academic community through consideration for others and a positive influence.

2. Recommendation (selection) eligibility and criteria
 - Current third-year students of this university's College of Engineering who will advance to fourth year in the 2027 academic year
 - Students who have contributed to building a sound academic community
 - Students whose leadership, through consideration for others and a positive influence, sets an example at regional and national level

3. Selection plan and payment
 - Number selected: one student recommended per department (school). Note: one student is selected for the College of Engineering.
 - Amount: USD 10,000 per person per year
 Note: the 2027 amount is 13,296,090 won per person (the amount paid in won changes every year according to the exchange rate applied when the fund is transferred).
 - Selection method: students recommended by departments (schools) are reviewed with advice from the selection advisers, examined by the College of Engineering Scholarship Committee, and one final recipient is selected.
 - Payment plan: the recipient is selected in the second semester of the third year, and the scholarship is allocated and paid as a Development Foundation designated scholarship [발전재단 특지장학금] in the first semester of the fourth year.
 Note: in the first year, one student each is selected from the College of Engineering and the College of Social Sciences; from the following year, one student is selected in alternate years (order: College of Engineering → College of Social Sciences).
 Note: the selected student will be invited to the scholarship award ceremony planned for the end of February each year, and attendance is mandatory.

4. Deadline and method of application: submit one copy of each required document by email to the department office by 17:00 on Wednesday, 25 November 2026 (the email address is in the original notice).
[Required documents] Self-introduction [자기소개서] (must include your values in life so far and your resolve for the future); recommendation letter [추천서] (from the dean, your academic advisor or an acquaintance); academic transcript [성적증명서]; additional submission: evidence of activities during university, if any (volunteering, student council and other group activities, awards and commendations); and the Jeongjik scholarship recommendation list [정직장학생 추천 명단] (attached Excel file).

Attachments
1. First Jeongjik Scholarship operating plan [제1회 정직장학금 운영(안)], 1 copy.
2. Self-introduction and recommendation letter forms, 1 copy each.
3. Recommendation list, 1 copy.
Attached files (3): 2027학년도 정직장학생 추천 양식.xlsx (12 KB); 정직장학 자기소개서 및 추천서.hwp (26 KB); 제1회 정직장학금 운영(안).docx (21 KB).

(The contents of the attached files were not provided and have not been read.)
